title: StageWell: A Process-Aligned Chinese Corpus for Positive-Psychology Support Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2608.29326v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Positive psychology dialogue aims to support emotional distress and positive resource building, requiring models to produce not only empathetic replies but also coherent progression through a multi-turn support process. Existing resources often reduce supervision to turn-level strategies or holistic preference labels, leaving process position, support function, and local repair targets implicit. We introduce StageWell, a process-aligned Chinese corpus for positive psychology dialogue, together with HQS, a structured protocol for data construction and evaluation. StageWell organizes support into a six-stage support process and uses a multi-agent whole-dialogue rewriting workflow to construct 12,445 SFT instances, 1,849 DPO preference pairs, and a GroundTruth subset of 120 expert-revised dialogues and 977 QA pairs. translated_title: StageWell：面向积极心理学支持对话的过程对齐中文语料库
translated_abstract: 积极心理学对话旨在支持情绪困扰缓解和积极资源建设，要求模型不仅能生成共情回复，还需在多轮支持过程中实现连贯的阶段推进。现有资源往往将监督信号简化为轮次级策略或整体偏好标签，使得过程位置、支持功能和局部修复目标处于隐式状态。我们提出了StageWell——一个面向积极心理学对话的过程对齐中文语料库，并配套HQS，一个用于数据构建与评估的结构化协议。StageWell将支持过程组织为六个阶段，并采用多智能体全对话重写工作流，构建了12,445个SFT实例、1,849个DPO偏好对，以及包含120个专家修订对话和977个问答对的GroundTruth子集。在HQS的指导下，DPO偏好对被构建为过程定位的修复形式：将有缺陷的模型输出作为被拒绝的响应，将……
tldr: 本文提出了StageWell——一个基于六阶段支持流程构建的过程对齐中文积极心理学对话语料库，配合HQS结构化协议，通过多智能体全对话重写工作流生成SFT实例、过程定位的DPO偏好对及专家修订基准数据，使模型能够在多轮心理支持过程中实现连贯的阶段推进与局部修复。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces StageWell, a process-aligned Chinese corpus for positive psychology support dialogue organized around a six-stage support process, together with the HQS structured protocol, which leverages a multi-agent whole-dialogue rewriting workflow to construct SFT instances, process-localized DPO preference pairs, and expert-revised ground-truth data for coherent multi-turn support progression.
